route.name: The Atlantic Winners Decision Loop
route.direction: Boston to Newport and New Haven, through New York and Pennsylvania to Washington and Richmond, returning through Philadelphia, Princeton, and Connecticut
route.summary: The final group decision route keeps 21 scored core experiences, one scheduled arrival-day option, and 17 visible corridor choices outside the baseline. Beinecke remains locked on Day 2 and every optional place preserves its original shared ratings.
route.route_dna: GROUP WINNERS × PLAYFUL MACHINES × STRANGE ARCHITECTURE × SACRED INTERIORS

constraints.visa_policy: US-only; no Canada crossing or J-1 re-entry dependency.
constraints.route_specific_drive_rule: Every baseline day is at or below 210 minutes; Allentown and Rye are explicit comfort breaks on the two longest transfer lines.
